title: Breach

{{About|the game content in Keepers league|the original version introduced in Breach league|Breach (original)|other uses|Breach (disambiguation)}}

'''Breach''' content involves otherworldly monsters who have stabilized their interdimensional rift to [[Wraeclast]] and have begun constructing hives throughout the land, first introduced in [[Keepers league]]. It is the sequel of the original [[Breach (original)|Breach]] mechanic from [[Breach league]].

==Overview==
Breaches can be encountered starting from [[The Mud Flats (Act 6)|The Mud Flats]] in [[Act 6]]. Players can find [[Ailith, First of the Keepers]] near the entrance in [[The Coast (Act 6)|The Coast]], and will provide an introduction to the mechanic.

Breaches are split into two types: Unstable Breaches and Breach Hives. A Breach encounter will feature either one of these encounters, but never both. In maps, a Hive Fortress has a chance to spawn over Breach Hives. In maps, the chance to encounter a Breach Hive/Unstable Breach/Hive Fortress is approximately 40%/45%/15% respectively<ref>reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1ozbi6u/data_on_breach_and_wombgift_chances/</ref>{{confirm|due to 3.28}} The keystones {{psl|Dimensional Foothold}} and {{psl|Enemy at the Gates}} cause all Breach encounters to be Breach Hives or Unstable Breaches, respectively. Note that Breach Hives/Hive Fortresses have priority over Unstable Breaches, and if either a Hive or Fortress is forced to spawn, it will prevent Unstable Breaches from spawning.

All Breach encounters grant an amount of Hiveblood and a chance for one or more [[wombgift]]s to drop on successful completion.

===Unstable Breach===
[[File:Keepers unstable breach.png|thumb|200px|An Unstable Breach.]]
[[File:Keepers unstable breach timer.png|thumb|The Unstable Breach timer.]]
Unstable Breaches appear as a massive Breach Hand. Touching it will open an Unstable Breach, expanding outwards for a duration while Breach monsters will spawn in. Breach monsters are unable to leave the circle. A progress bar will appear with two bars: one that increases based on killing Hiveborn monsters, and one that gradually increases over time. The goal is to fill the bar from killing Hiveborn before the timer catches up, collapsing the Breach encounter prematurely.

Defeating enough Breach monsters to fill up the bar will cause the timer to accelerate to max, forming a Stabilized Breach, stopping the timer and Breach expansion. When this occurs, several Rare Hiveborn monsters (and sometimes in maps, [[Vruun, Marshal of Xesht]]) near the location of the Breach Hand that must be defeated to successfully collapse the Stabilized Breach. Note that players are intentionally not expected to be able to stabilize Unstable Breaches during the earlier parts of the [[campaign]].

After the Breach collapses, whether it was stabilized or not, loot will drop in a spiral near the [[character]]'s current location.

Vruun also always drops a rare [[Breach ring (disambiguation)|Breach ring]] base type, and sometimes a {{il|Hivebrain Gland}}, {{il|Pyre Support}}, or {{il|Bonespire Support}}.

It is possible to spawn multiple Unstable Breaches in the same area. Up to 2 Breaches can be open at a time (stabilized or otherwise).

===Breach Hive===
[[File:Keepers Breach hive.jpg|thumb|400px|A Breach Hive.]]
Breach Hives appear as a large breach circle containing Breach monsters and semi-organic structures within them. Before beginning the encounter, players can destroy the Breach walls by approaching them or by hitting them. There are also several Flammable Burrows scattered within the Breach Hive, indicated as faded purple dots on the mini-map. Approaching them will create a large explosion that clears all walls within its radius and cause other nearby flammable burrows within range to explode as well. At the center of the Hive at the core (marked by a Breach hand on the minimap) is a button that will summon Ailith, which begins the encounter where the player must defend her against waves of monsters while she prepares a ritual to destroy the Hive.

Once the encounter begins, walking near the hive walls or attacking them will no longer destroy them. The Hiveborn will spawn from rifts that can reach Ailith, indicated as red dots on the minimap. As you progress through the waves, more of the hive walls may get destroyed. Destroying more of the structure before summoning Ailith will allow more monsters to approach and attack Ailith. Each wave progresses when you kill enough Hiveborn, with every new wave causing a pulse to release from the statue and spawning new enemies and potentially destroying more walls. Hive encounters consist of 5 to 8 waves of enemies.

Ailith has a health bar with 20 segments somewhat similar to [[Blight (game mechanic)|Blight]]; being hit by Hiveborn monsters' skills causes Ailith to take damage to this health bar, and fully depleting the bar before completing the final wave will fail the encounter. Damage is roughly based on the enemy rarity and the strength of the attack, and Ailith has a brief period of invulnerability between taking damage with the duration proportional to the amount of damage taken. While Ailith is channelling, the player can use the nearby purple flames by interact with their icons to gain various helpful effects:
* '''Heal Ailith''': Restores some of Ailith's health bar.
* '''Give Ailith a Shield''': Protects Ailith from taking damage for a duration.
* '''Gain an Enhanced Flame''': Grants a buff to your character that deals significant damage over time to nearby enemies, somewhat similar to {{il|Righteous Fire}}, and destroy nearby walls.
* '''Create a Wall of the Dreamer's Flame''': Creates a long purple flame wall that deals significant damage over time enemies it touches.
* '''Freeze and Hinder the Hiveborn''': Temporarily inflicts nearby Hiveborn with {{stl|Freeze}} and {{stl|Hinder}} over a large area.
* '''Bombard the Hiveborn''': Summons a hail of meteors to attack the Hiveborn, dealing area damage for a long duration.

Hiveborn monsters will generally prioritize attacking characters over Ailith, with an aggro range of approximately a screen wide.

After completing a Hive encounter, loot will drop in a spiral at the statue's location. If the encounter is failed, all the loot from killed monsters will drop, but no Hiveblood or Wombgifts will be awarded.

===Hive Fortress===
[[File:Hive Fortress entrance.jpg|thumb|The entrance to a Hive Fortress.]]
[[File:Keepers hive fortress.jpg|thumb|400px|Inside a Hive Fortress.]]
[[File:Breach Fortress minimap.jpg|thumb|Hive Fortress minimap layout.]]
{{main|Hive Fortress}}
In any tier of [[map]], a Breach Hive may be replaced with a [[Hive Fortress]], a side area containing more Hiveborn monsters. Hive Fortresses belong to the same instance as the main map. The area contains several "Grasping Coffer" [[chest]]s that can sometimes contain [[wombgift]]s and [[Foulborn unique item]]s.

In the center of the Hive Fortress, a more difficult version of a Hive encounter can be found. These encounters have 24 waves. During the encounter, additional purple flames (skills and buffs) will spawn once every few waves. Up to 6 purple flames can be held on reserve at a time, so it is recommended to use them liberally.

In addition to purple flame skills found in regular Hive encounters, there is one special skill available at the start:
* '''Destroy the Hive walls around Ailith''': Optionally destroys the walls that funnel monsters towards Ailith. This skill is removed if not used by wave 4.

After completing the Hive encounter, the Breach hand will start pulsing, doing physical damage across the whole area in intervals. This damage is affected by map modifiers and can be mitigated or [[block]]ed. The player must escape from the Hive Fortress successfully in order to collect their rewards. Hands will emerge from the walls to block off several paths and corridors; these appear in the minimap within a wide radius as a small grey hand icon. There is typically only one route to the outer ring of the arena which then leads directly to the exit, and it is possible to start planning the initial route of escape during the waves.

Escaping successfully will grant a significant amount of Hiveblood and drop several [[wombgift]]s and sometimes a {{il|Hivebrain Gland}}.

Dying after starting the waves or while escaping will prevent re-entry and will drop rewards earned so far, but no Hiveblood or wombgifts.

==Version history==
As part of changes introduced in Keepers league to provide "deterministic rewards" during the campaign<ref>https://youtu.be/gmH6W6u5beM?si=glkBVmjGwH1h_QU4&t=6483</ref>, completing any Breach encounter for the first time on a new character in [[Act 5]]'s [[The Slave Pens]] and [[Act 6]]'s [[The Twilight Strand (Act 6)|The Twilight Strand]] guaranteed a random 5-link body armour, for a total of two opportunities per character.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QIDyUG5ms2w</ref> This applied in any [[Keepers league]]-parented league containing new Breach content, including the [[Legacy of Phrecia]] event.

{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* The average number of Monsters in Breach Monster packs has been reduced.
* The number of Monster packs spawned in Unstable Breaches has been reduced by 25%. The progress for killing Breach Monsters has been increased by 17% to compensate for the reduced number of Monsters.
* The maximum number of Unstable Breaches that can be open at once has been reduced to 2 (previously 3).
* These changes do not affect the amount of Hiveblood or Wombgifts you receive.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.28.0|
* You now encounter Ailith for the first time at the Mud Flats entrance in the Coast in Act 6, where she will enlist your aid in the fight against the Hiveborn.
* Breach Hives and Unstable Breaches now spawn in areas from Act 6 Mud Flats onwards.
* Multiple Unstable Breaches can spawn in areas. However, Breach Hives and Unstable Breaches cannot both be present in areas. Areas also cannot contain more than one Breach Hive.
* Breach Hives in areas have approximately 30% less radius.
* Reduced the visual size of walls and other objects within Breach Hive encounters.
* Walls within Breach Hives can now be instantly destroyed by damage from players and their allies. This can only be done while the encounter is not in progress.
* The following items have been removed, and existing items will be deleted upon logging in: Fleshgraft, Growing Wombgift, Augmentation Implant, Exalted Implant, Regal Implant, Unstable Implant, Draining Eshgraft, Jolting Eshgraft, Replicating Eshgraft, Storming Eshgraft, Aegis Tulgraft, Freezing Tulgraft, Squalling Tulgraft, Summoning Tulgraft, Battering Uulgraft, Hardening Uulgraft, Impaling Uulgraft, Spiking Uulgraft, Erupting Xophgraft, Flamecaller Xophgraft, Molten Xophgraft, and Stoking Xophgraft.
* Hivebrain Glands now directly open portals to a Hive Colony, rather than being used alongside a Map to add an entrance to a Hive Colony within that area.
* Graftblood has been renamed to Hiveblood.
* The Graft Locker no longer stores Graft Items and has been renamed to "Wombgift Locker" as a result.
* Several passives on the Genesis Tree have been rebalanced to make the rewards more appropriate for a core league.
* There is now more variance at endgame for the Item Level of items generated from growing Equipment Wombs on the Genesis Tree, and removed most sources of guaranted additional Item Levels.
* The Breachlord Achievement now requires you to kill It That Was Tul and It That Was Esh.
* Ailith no longer sells Fleshgrafts.
* Hiveblood no longer requires Grafts to store, and has a maximum capacity of 100,000. Hiveblood is shared across all characters within a League.
* Added several Breach clusters to the Atlas Passive Tree.
* Added a new Atlas Keystone, Dimensional Foothold, which grants Breach encounters in your Maps are always Hives.
* Added a new Atlas Keystone, Enemy at the Gates, which grants Breach encounters in your Maps are always unstable Breaches.
* Existing Valdo Maps with "Area contains the Hidden" instead now grant "Area contains the Remembered".
* Existing Valdo Maps with "Area contains a Breachlord and Area contains additional Breaches" instead now have "Area contains additional Unstable Breaches". All Unstable Breaches must be Stabilised and Closed in order to claim the reward from the area.
* All Breach Scarabs have been reworked, the Breach Scarab has been renamed to Breach Scarab of the Hive and has Area contains a Breach Hive.
* Breach Scarab of Snares has been renamed to Breach Scarab of Instability and has Area contains 2 additional Unstable Breaches.
* Breach Scarab of Lordship has been renamed to Breach Scarab of the Marshal and has Unstable Breaches in Area contain a Boss, and Breach Hives in Area lead to a Hive Fortress.
* Breach Scarab of Splintering has been renamed to Breach Scarab of the Incensed Swarm and has Ailith's skills in Area instead enrage the Hive, increasing the Difficulty and Reward of subsequent waves.
* Breach Scarab of Resonant Cascade now has Unstable Breaches in Areas are 10% faster for each Unstable Breach already opened, and Monsters from Unstable Breaches in Areas have increased Difficulty and Reward for each Unstable Breach already opened.
* Increased the penalty to Gold and Map drops on Breach and Blight monsters.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0g|
* Fixed a bug where Ailith in Breach Hive and Hive Fortress encounters could be affected by certain Map Modifiers.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0d|
* Breach Hive Fortress encounters will now contain a skill that destroys all the walls around [[Ailith]], available from the start of the encounter.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0c|
* Increased the amount of Graftblood and Wombgifts you get back from Breach Hive encounters in areas. The buffs are most prominent in higher level areas with up to 50% more Graftblood in level 83 Maps. Hive Fortresses grant up to 25% more Graftblood in level 83 Maps.
* Increased the number of monster packs that spawn each wave in regular Breach Hive encounters in Maps, up to 80% more packs in level 83 Maps.
* Increased the breakable Hive pack spawners by 40% in Maps.
* Slightly increased the number of Breach monster packs spawned within a Breach Hive.
* Slightly increased the number of Skill objects granted by Ailith in Breach Hive encounters in Maps.
* Slaying It that was Esh and It that was Tul will now grant players Graftblood.
* In Breach Hive encounters, destroying a burnable Hive pack spawner will now release a wave of purple flame destroying all walls within a 7.5 metre radius. The wave can chain react causing any other spawner objects burnt to release additional waves.
* Added a variety of obstructions to the centre of Hive Fortress encounters to channel monster paths.
* Fixed the flame aura that burns Breach Hive walls having a visual radius lower than the actual burn radius.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0b|
* Monsters that are targeting [[Ailith]] will now move closer before using their skills.
* Ailith will create skills more frequently during Hive Fortress encounters. Note there is a maximum of 6 skill objects active at a time.
* Increased the cooldown for which Ailith cannot be damaged for after taking damage. This cooldown becomes longer the more damage she takes from an individual hit.
* Failing a Breach Hive or Hive Fortress encounter will now drop all the loot of the monsters you had killed up to that point. You will not however gain any Graftblood or Wombgifts.
* Rare Breach and [[Blight (game mechanic)|Blight Monsters]] can no longer spawn with the [[Soul Eater]] modifier.
* Breach Encounter skills can now be activated by pressing the 'League Interface' bind (default 'V') while in range.
* Fixed desync that could occur with Unstable Breaches which caused them to sometimes appear already expanded.
* (Hotfix 2) Fixed a bug where packs of monsters near Shrines were not spawning if the Shrine was located within a Breach Hive.
* (Hotfix 2) The 'League Interface' bind (default 'V') can no longer trigger actions other than Breach encounter skills while in range and the encounter is in progress.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0|
* Introduced to the game in [[Keepers league]].
** The original version of [[Breach (original)|Breach]] is still available in [[permanent league]]s, though any changes that do not specify Keepers of the Flame League still apply. {{Undocumented}}

* The Breach and Imbued Breach Map Device Crafting Options have been removed.
* (Hotfix 6) Increased the chances of finding body parts from in-area Breach encounters.
* (Hotfix 6) Unstable Breaches now progress slower until they collapse, particularly in the very early game. Note: You are not expected to be able to Stabilise the Unstable Breaches early on.
* (Hotfix 6) Ailith's "Conjure a wall of the Dreamer's Flame" is now removed when the Breach Hive encounter ends.
* (Hotfix 6) Fixed a bug where the "Gain an Enhanced Flame" skill during Hive encounters was not visually giving you the flame, and it dealt damage but didn't burn down walls.
